ExperienceSection.title: Work Journey
ExperienceSection.description: Milestones from shipping client products and owning DevOps delivery.

bullets: Promoted from intern within six months; now deliver features end-to-end on three concurrent client products in teams of 5–15 engineers, from technical design through code review to AWS release.

Serve as primary DevOps engineer across client work, standardizing Terraform infrastructure-as-code and GitHub Actions pipelines into reusable templates now shared across client projects and environments.
Eliminated a recurring class of frontend–backend integration defects by introducing type-safe API contracts generated from OpenAPI as a team-wide standard.
Uphold release quality through Gitflow code review, and own the architecture documentation that shortened new-joiner ramp-up.
Work directly with overseas product owners and designers in English, turning business requirements into sprint-level technical plans.
Built Gitman, an internal Git repository management tool, from scratch with Vue.js, TypeScript, Nest.js, and MongoDB, and released it for company-wide internal use.
Shipped Vue 3 and TypeScript workflow features into the production HRM platform as one of 20 engineers, then moved onto client-facing product work at the end of the internship.

Projects.title: Projects
Projects.description: Full write-ups from client and personal work — context, ownership, and what shipped.

kotae.title: Kotae — AI Chatbot Platform
kotae.summary: AI-powered chatbot SaaS for SME customer support, combining RAG-based knowledge Q&A with omnichannel messaging.
bullets: Owned end-to-end delivery from early product stages across Nest.js APIs, Next.js admin/embed UI, and AWS/GitOps (Docker/ECR, Helm, Terraform Cognito/S3).
Built Nest.js chat/Socket.io session flows and Redis/Bull jobs for analytics aggregation and email on MongoDB + OpenAI/LangChain.
Shipped Next.js chatbot configuration, knowledge-base training workflows, history/analytics dashboards, and an embeddable widget with WordPress publish flows.

starlive.title: StarLive — Live Streaming Platform
starlive.summary: Paid live-streaming and 1:1 video-call platform with real-time per-minute billing and cross-app RTC integration.
bullets: Built the admin live-monitoring console with multi-room Tencent TRTC playback, IM chat logs, viewer lists, and moderator actions (force kick/end/premium), shared across admin and production apps via a Turborepo package.
Implemented recording review and livestream session analytics UIs—playback/detail with tags and comments, session stats, timeline charts, and consumption rankings.
Delivered agency production-fee settlement workflows with bulk confirm/success-fail actions and EN/JA localization.
Led Turborepo monorepo migration of the admin frontend (Next.js), extracting shared packages and aligning Docker/CI for workspace builds.

ercBooking.title: ERC Booking — Clinic Scheduling
ercBooking.summary: Clinic scheduling platform with RBAC user management, automated multi-env infrastructure, and multilingual notification pipeline.
bullets: Led DevOps for a clinic booking platform, provisioning multi-env AWS infrastructure with Terraform (VPC, ECS Fargate, Aurora, Redis, ALB, CloudFront, S3, SQS, SES).
Owned GitHub Actions CI/CD for S3/CloudFront frontend deploys, ECR/ECS backend rollouts, and Liquibase database migrations across environments.
Built Nest.js RBAC APIs and React admin features for user/role management with OpenAPI-synced clients.
Implemented an async email pipeline via SQS workers and SES SMTP with multilingual Handlebars templates.

hrm.title: HRM Platform — Human Resources
hrm.summary: Internal human resource management system covering employee, timekeeping, and HR workflow modules.
bullets: Built and refined HR workflows UI with Vue 3 and TypeScript for a production system serving 50+ internal employees, improving usability and stability.
Implemented Nest.js APIs and MySQL data layer for core HR modules.
Fixed bugs and iterated UX based on internal user feedback.

portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
portfolio.summary: Multilingual personal portfolio showcasing projects and professional profile, with automated CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
bullets: Built a multilingual portfolio (EN/VI) with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, next-intl, and Motion.

Defined the AWS infrastructure in Terraform (VPC, ECR, IAM OIDC role for GitHub Actions, SSM parameters) and the Kubernetes layer as Argo CD GitOps with Helm charts, External Secrets and Prometheus/Grafana.

Automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions: lint, type-check and build on every pull request; arm64 images pushed to Amazon ECR through OIDC and promoted via the GitOps repo with smoke tests and automatic rollback; Telegram alerts for contact form submissions.
